# Task
Task: ajcr-alignment-tags
Title: AJCR alignment tagging: REFERENCE / ADAPTED / CUSTOM / TO CHECK
Project(s) — work across all of them:
- Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge-Rebuild at MainProjects/Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge-Rebuild

CLASSIFICATION ONLY. Read the complete AJCR mathematical blueprint, its cited references, every AJCR roadmap item that makes a mathematical claim, and the corresponding blueprint-linked or root-critical public Lean declarations. Assign exactly one visible provenance tag to each mathematical element: REFERENCE when it closely follows a precise reference statement and argument; ADAPTED when it is reference-based but reformulated, combined, strengthened, or substantially adapted; CUSTOM when no close reference theorem supports the project-specific construction. Add the optional visible modifier TO CHECK only when a concrete possible source-blueprint, blueprint-Lean, roadmap-statement, quantifier, hypothesis, or conclusion mismatch is noticed. TO CHECK is an attention marker, never a verdict that the mathematics is false. Make the tags directly visible to humans in rendered blueprint TeX and in concise Lean declaration docstrings, and preserve or mirror them in hgraph so graph queries can expose them. A TO CHECK marker may carry one short factual reason and an evidence pointer. Mathematical roadmap entries may receive TO CHECK where relevant; do not relabel purely operational entries. Minimal tag-rendering and hgraph-discoverability plumbing, including one concise Horizon-skill instruction telling future lanes to inspect TO CHECK before working on a node, is in scope. NOTHING ELSE IS IN SCOPE: do not fix statements, change proofs, add lemmas, judge correctness, assign verdicts or severities, restructure the roadmap, change roadmap status or priority, create follow-up issues/tasks, or rewrite mathematical exposition beyond inserting the markers. Do not tag internal implementation-only Lean helpers. Work in bounded chapter slices, commit each completed slice, and report coverage counts and unclassified residue only. Because another AJCR lane is active, do not run a full lake build; validate only the blueprint rendering, hgraph sync, and checks strictly required for comment-only Lean changes.

This is a headless, one-shot session: advance the REAL objective, commit each
verified unit and any final edits, keep operational comments to the delta,
then write the skill's brief final report.
